messages.author: 1b71523bc7711ba8
messages.subject: getUnitNames
parts:
Hi Hendrik and colleagues,

getUnitNames returns the Affymetrix IDs. Is there any way to alter it
so that it returns the dbSNP reference SNP identifiers; ie, the IDs
begin with the prefix rs?

Thanks,
Matt

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] getUnitNames
parts:
Hi Matt,

getUnitNames() does not return dbSNP identifiers, because these are
not embedded in CDF files. I don't know of an easy way to use
aroma.affymetrix methods (Henrik - is there one?) to get the mapping
from probe set ID to dbSNP ID (where this exists), but it shouldn't be
too hard to "roll your own" starting with the appropriate CSV file
from Netaffx, or a dChip SNP information file if this is available for
the chip you are using.

Cheers,

Ken

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: getUnitNames
parts:
Hi,

this is to confirm that there is nothing in aroma.affymetrix that
takes you from Affymetrix unit names (probeset IDs) to dbSNP RS IDs.
As Ken suggests, the most straightforward is to retrieve this
information from the Affymetrix NetAffx CSV files, e.g. by using
read.table() [set colClasses="NULL" for unwanted column].

Cheers

Henrik
